verdict.rationale: Anytime Mailbox is a virtual mailbox SaaS. Such a service could plausibly offer automation rules, such as auto-scan or auto-forward, along with version history and rollback, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only shows manual, per-item requests (scan, forward, shred, pickup scheduling) and multi-user access. Nothing in the pack covers automation definitions, versioning, review, or rollback, and the probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI spec.
